subject: Shiny is not up to date.  Supports ubuntu 12, but will not work on ubuntu 16 due to libssl0.9.8 dep

messages.author: a3db5f3187bdbb9e
messages.subject: Shiny is not up to date.  Supports ubuntu 12, but will not work on ubuntu 16 due to libssl0.9.8 dep
parts:
Is there any chance that Shiny server will be brought into alignment with modern ubuntu systems?  Shiny server depends on libssl0.9.8, but the current version of Ubuntu that package is deprecated in favor of libssl1.0.0

I would like to install Shiny, but I don't want to compromise the integrity of my system by downgrading my libssl.
